Archived: full-game roadmap (August 2026)

This folder is a snapshot of the 18-phase / ~14-week-to-co-op build plan. It is not the active plan.

Active plan: ../../00_POC_PLAYABLE_LOOP.md — Pirate Raid playable loop, menus, settings, debug sliders, placeholder art.

Why archived: The full catalog over-specified Hub, hex grid, 30 ships, Heat, and 4-player before a ship existed. North-star design still lives in design/. This snapshot is kept so later horizon steps (hulls, co-op, stations) can be pulled back without reinventing them.
